name: graphite
description: Two models get the same CSV. Both write matplotlib code. The sandbox executes it. The judge picks the chart that actually answers the question.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,gateway,executor "pnpm run dev:web" "pnpm run dev:gateway" "pnpm run dev:executor"
scripts.dev:executor: sh -c "if [ -x .venv/bin/uvicorn ]; then UV=.venv/bin/uvicorn; else UV=uvicorn; fi; MPLCONFIGDIR=$PWD/.mplcache $UV executor:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000 --app-dir backend"
